github_commit.commit_message: Declare HDF5 reader functions only when HDF5 is enabled

cache.hash_definition: sha256 over the schema text and every row of tables datasets and estimates (sorted, JSON, floats rounded to 6 decimals); no timestamps; maps table excluded

citations: Burkhart, B. et al. 2020, ApJ 905, 14 (CATS), doi:10.3847/1538-4357/abc484
Portillo, S. K. N. et al. 2018, ApJ 862, 119
Bialy, S. & Burkhart, B. 2020, ApJ 894, L2
Stone, J. M. et al. 2020, ApJS 249, 4 (Athena++)
Chen, C.-Y. et al. 2019, MNRAS 485, 3499, doi:10.1093/mnras/stz618

alfven_speed_convention.athenapp: v_A = B / sqrt(rho): code units with mu = 1 (no 4 pi), Stone et al. 2020
alfven_speed_convention.cats_cho_eno: not computed: no velocity cubes and field units not specified

athdf.acquired_by: local output of my own Athena++ run (upstream artifact identified by SHA-256; the simulation is reproducible to tolerance only)

run_metadata.conventions: rho=1, mu=1 so v_A=b0; M_A=v_rms/b0 with 3D rms speed over the box

machine.fftw_hdf5:
fftw                       3.3.11           nompi_haf1500d_100  conda-forge
hdf5                       2.2.0            nompi_h1e41424_102  conda-forge

outputs.reproducibility_note: outputs depend on compiler/CPU; not bit-identical across machines

transformations: rho normalised to <rho> = 1; B normalised to |<B>| (tilt is unit-free)
dB/B0 = rms(B - <B>) / |<B>| over the full cube
tilted line of sight: rotate_maps.rotated_maps (trilinear sampling, periodic wrap) at angles 0,15,30,45,60,75,90
Stokes Q, U, polarization fraction p with intrinsic p0 = 0.15 (Chen et al. 2019, eqs. 1-3)
p0 derived from p_max (eq. 9) with p_max = map maximum ('max') or 99.5th percentile
tilt inversion gamma = arccos(sqrt(cos^2 gamma)) from p (eq. 10)
S cut: pixels with dispersion S below the median S ('low-S'); outer pixel ring masked
KDE peak (Gaussian, Scott's rule) on a 0-90 degree grid
read .athdf with h5py: prim (rho, vel1-3) and B (Bcc1-3) datasets, single-level mesh
M_s = v_rms / iso_sound_speed; M_A = v_rms / (|<B>| / sqrt(<rho>))  [mu = 1 units]
